page_title: LUT 1-5 BRE | Luton v Brentford 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Neal Maupay (Brentford) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
90+5' Teden Mengi (Luton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
90+5' The attendance is 11877.

90+4' Close! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

90+2' 1 - 5 Luke Berry (Luton) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' The foul by Alfie Doughty (Luton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
86' 0 - 5 Goal! Vitaly Janelt plays a simple square pass into the feet of Kevin Schade (Brentford) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 0:5.
85' The rebound finds Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the right post. That was a promising chance!
84' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

84' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Neal Maupay, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
82' Here is a change. Yoane Wissa is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Neal Maupay (Brentford).
82' That will be all from Mathias Jensen who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Clark will be replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
79' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Thomas Kaminski leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
76' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) replacing Kristoffer Ajer.
73' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal and raises his hands to celebrate, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to deny his attempt.
71' Substitution. Kevin Schade (Brentford) has come on for Keane Lewis-Potter.
71' It will be a substitution. Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Mikkel Damsgaard walks off.
71' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga is replaced by Daiki Hashioka (Luton).
71' Substitution. Tahith Chong did his best and is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
69' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

68' Fred Onyedinma (Luton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. It's a free kick to Brentford, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
66' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

64' 0 - 4 Bryan Mbeumo sends a superb cross into the box. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Thomas Kaminski beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:4.
62' 0 - 3 Sergio Reguilon takes the corner and Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the top left corner. The score is 0:3.
61' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
61' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Fred Onyedinma (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.

59' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
58' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
56' Luke Berry (Luton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jarred Gillett saw the whole situation. Brentford are awarded the free kick.
55' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
55' The resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Tahith Chong (Luton). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
52' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul after Jordan Clark (Luton) hacks down one of his opponents.
49' The free kick is taken by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but ball is cleared.
48' Caution goes to Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.

46' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Reece Burke (Luton) is replaced by Luke Berry.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+4' Carlton Morris (Luton) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
45+2' Referee Jarred Gillett points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Brentford players celebrate.
45+2' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Jarred Gillett is going to take a look using VAR.
45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' OFF THE BAR! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
43' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
38' Tahith Chong (Luton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
38' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
37' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brentford.
35' Rob Edwards is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Issa Kabore (Luton) suffers an injury and Fred Onyedinma comes on.
34' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Tahith Chong (Luton) inside the box.
33' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
32' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
31' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Brentford win a corner.
29' Issa Kabore (Luton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Issa Kabore (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
28' Issa Kabore (Luton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Tahith Chong (Luton) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
26' The corner kick from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
25' A pass from Issa Kabore (Luton) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down. Luton force a corner. They send men into the box.

24' 0 - 1 Bryan Mbeumo passes to Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the top right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:1.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.

20' A header by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) from very close range goes towards the right-hand post, but doesn't get past Thomas Kaminski, who makes a brilliant save. Brentford force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

19' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
18' Referee Jarred Gillett sees the trip by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
14' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Jordan Clark (Luton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
11' A loose ball is pounced on by Alfie Doughty (Luton) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken is alert and makes a comfortable save.
8' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
4' The foul by Carlton Morris (Luton) was seen by Jarred Gillett who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
2' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
2' Jordan Clark (Luton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
1' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

Luton will kick the game off.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
